## Carga de librerías

```{r}
library(pacman)
library(here)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Carga de datos

```{r}
censo <- read.csv(
  here("TP3", "data", "adult_census_USA.csv"))
```

## Transformación de variable

```{r}
censo <- censo %>%
  mutate(
    income = factor(income, levels = c("<=50K", ">50K"))
  )
```

## Limpieza de base

```{r}
censo <- censo %>%
  select(
    age, education_num, marital_status, race, sex, hours_per_week, income) %>% 
  mutate(
    marital_status = if_else(
      marital_status %in% c(
        "Married-civ-spouse",
        "Married-spouse-absent",
        "Married-AF-spouse"),
      "married",
      "single"))
```

## Verificación de balance 

```{r}
summary(censo)
```
